sloka: स वै विषयपर्यन्ते तव राजन्महातपाः ।अद्य तप्यति दुर्बुद्धिस्तेन बालवधो ह्ययम् ।। ७.७४.२८ ॥
transliteration: sa vai viṣayaparyante tava rājanmahātapāḥ ।adya tapyati durbuddhistena bālavadho hyayam ।। 7.74.28 ॥

translations.english: That very great ascetic, O King, is indeed performing penance today at the border of your kingdom, and it is by this foolish act that this child's death has occurred.
